title: Musicians who impressed and disappointed him
summary: Bull lists Jim Robinson, George Lewis, Chester Zardes, Manuel Paul, Kid Thomas and others who impressed him, and says he was unimpressed with Frog Joseph.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Who are some of the musicians who've really impressed you there? The musicians that really impressed me are Jim, especially Jim.

George, of course, Lewis Nelson, Chester Zardes, one of the most of all, possibly because I didn't expect to see him and because he just plays excellent bass. Soi, Sammy Penn, Manuel Paul very, very much. I think Manuel Paul is one of the best players I've heard here. Thomas. Kid Thomas. Kid Thomas. I like Frank Miliere. I quite like Sweet Emma's playing. Joe Butler is a good singer and quite a good bass player. I wouldn't say he's excellent. I like drag, the night drag played. Alec Bigard, he has impressed me at times. As you know, he tends to be a little bit unsteady at times. Who else now? That's about all, so far. Except John Handy, of course. Where else have you been? I've been to England.
No, in New Orleans. Oh, wait a minute.
This reminds me, Albert Pertman impressed me quite well. I was very unimpressed. Better not say who I was unimpressed with. Better not.
But, uh... I can restrict it.
Well, I was surprisingly unimpressed with Frog Joseph for one.
